text:
**Legal compliance cannot be determined from this evidence alone.** The applicable forest laws, permits and official land records would need to be checked.

The satellite data show no forest on the property in the JRC 2020 reference. They also show 0.4 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2021, below the tool’s 0.5-hectare event threshold. Earlier tree-cover loss was recorded, including 67.7 hectares in 2020, but satellite observations alone do not establish whether that loss was lawful.

The MGAP 2021 source was unavailable, so the assessment lacks that additional reference.
